profile.name: Uthayagunasingam Vanojan
profile.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer & Solutions Architect

I specialize in designing and engineering end-to-end distributed applications, resilient cloud backends, and high-performance interactive interfaces. profile.statusText: Open for high-impact engineering & architecture engagements

projects.title: LuxeVista Resort Platform
projects.subtitle: Enterprise Hospitality & Room Reservation Mobile Suite
projects.description: A premier Android application for luxury resort and hotel operations. Incorporates real-time suite discovery, dynamic room booking, multi-guest scheduling, amenities concierge, and local SQLite data persistence with transactional safety.
highlights: Real-time room availability matrix and reservation checkout
Offline-first transactional local cache powered by SQLite
Granular concierge request tracker and amenity reservation

projects.title: FutureDesk Coworking Ecosystem
projects.subtitle: Smart Workspace Reservation & Desk Allocation Engine
projects.description: A next-generation enterprise hot-desking and coworking facility platform. Offers dynamic spatial floor mapping, instant seat reservations, meeting room scheduling, and role-based staff administration with MongoDB indexation.
highlights: Interactive graphical workspace layout and instant reservation sync
Microservice-ready RESTful architecture with secure JWT authorization
Comprehensive administrative booking dashboard and usage analytics

projects.title: FitZone Fitness Management
projects.subtitle: Comprehensive Gym Operations & Trainer Booking Portal
projects.description: An integrated web management portal for elite fitness centers. Facilitates member profile management, trainer workout schedules, biometric progress tracking, subscription renewals, and administrative financial auditing.
highlights: Member subscription lifecycle and recurring renewal alerts
Trainer booking calendar and dynamic session scheduling
Highly optimized relational MySQL schema with relational constraints

projects.title: The Paws Shop ERP
projects.subtitle: Veterinary & Pet Supply Inventory Management System
projects.description: An enterprise desktop inventory management solution handling hundreds of SKU product lines, supplier purchasing cycles, barcode checkout, point-of-sale receipting, and low-inventory threshold triggers.
highlights: Automated low-stock safety alerts and supplier reorder triggers
Audited transaction histories with zero ledger discrepancies
Robust Java Swing desktop interface with accelerated shortcut keys

projects.title: Upcountry Warriors Engine
projects.subtitle: Competitive Sports Roster & Tournament Analytics Engine
projects.description: A high-performance C++ sports telemetry and club roster management engine. Processes player biometric statistics, match performance indexes, game strategies, and tournament rankings with low-latency execution.
highlights: Sub-millisecond analytical sorting for complex player metrics
Deep relational integrity between tournament rounds and rosters
